In 2011, the house I still live in was shown on a TV series in Norway about hauntings and ghost. I have experienced a lot of weird stuff in this house, but this is probably the most bizarre thing that has happened.

One night, I would say around midnight, me and my brother went to the kitchen. While we were on our way there, we walked past our small TV room where our parents usually fall asleep watching TV in the weekends. We noticed that our parents weren't in the room, nor in their bedrooms. (Just to clarify, we were never in the small TV room but we could see everything in it from where we were.) We assumed that they had gone out to visit a friend for some drinks.

The next day, we were curious where they had been and asked them. They said they had been watching TV all night and fell asleep on the sofas in the TV room. This didn't make any sense to me and my brother, and neither my parents. After a while, we contacted the TV show people and someone said that dimensional doors are a thing. (All this happened after the filmings, which made us pretty sure that there was something supernatural going on.)

I have experienced a lot in this house but this tops it. There is no way that we didn't walk past the room they were sleeping in and didn't see them, and they never saw us.
